meta.label: Host Config
meta.description: Read and apply whitelisted host-level configuration: install.ini keys, a systemd drop-in override for the DSS unit, and /etc/security/limits.d entries. Secret-material keys and non-whitelisted directives are refused inside this macro; every write backs the file up first.

params.name: file
params.label: File
params.description: apply only: install-ini, systemd-override or ulimits.

params.name: section
params.label: Section
params.description: install-ini only: the [section] to write into.

params.name: key
params.label: Key
params.description: install.ini key / systemd directive / ulimit item.

params.name: expected_current
params.label: Expected current value
params.description: Drift guard: apply refuses when the current value no longer matches (JSON-encoded; 'null' = expected absent).
